title: The lamps burn low and blue
description: The air down here is old. It has been breathing the same breath for years.

choices.text: Cross the bad stretch at a run.

onPass.narration: Out the far side gasping, and richer: a dropped purse in the middle of the stretch, where nobody stops to pick one up.

onFail.narration: Halfway across the lamps go out. You come through it on hands and knees.

choices.text: Sit down and wait for the draught to turn.

onPass.narration: The draught turns before the lamps do. An hour off the feet is an hour off the feet.

onFail.narration: The draught does not turn. You go through it anyway, later and no better for waiting.

choices.text: Take the long way round it.
